logos.attribution: Mapam; Shmuel Katz (poster designer); Central Zionist Archives KRA/3225. Crop from a dated official campaign publication, not a recreated emblem.
logos.inUseEvidence: CZA KRA/3225: exact catalogue year 1959 (not estimated), official Mapam campaign poster with issuer name and מ ballot roundel. 1959 had one Knesset election, 3 November. Year precision under decision 0089; the 22 November accession stamp is not a campaign date. Crop preserves original colours and the scan edge without redrawing.

dateEvidence.yearEvidence: CZA exhibition caption KRA/3225 explicitly gives 1959 without an estimate marker. The accession stamp is not used to date campaign use.
dateEvidence.campaignEvidence: Party-issued election poster: printed issuer מפלגת הפועלים המאוחדת (מפ״ם), Haifa; white מ ballot roundel; caption describes Mapam warning against voting Herut in 1959.
